description: Watch your open PRs and get the one prioritized action list: needs you now (new review findings, CI failing on your code, merge conflicts, new guard flags, stuck checks), waiting on them (checks running, green with no feedback yet), quiet. Compares against stored watermarks so reruns report only what changed since the last check. Cron-friendly: always succeeds unless the input is wrong.

author.description: Author whose open PRs to discover with mine.

mine.description: Discover the author's open PRs across the repos list via the GitHub search API.

pr_urls.description: Full GitHub PR URLs to watch, e.g. ["https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123"]. Empty when using mine.

repos.description: owner/repo list for mine discovery, e.g. ["acme/widgets"].

name: babysit_prs
